pr_title: Initial pass on touch support for swaybar
pr_body:
- Activate hotspots on tap
- Cycle workspaces on swipe

Future patches:

- Make padding (constants in `render.c`) configurable so my fat fingers have bigger targets
- Incorporate with #3697 to create new workspaces on swipe(?)

Fixes https://github.com/swaywm/sway/issues/2377

issue_context.title: Add touch support to swaybar
comments: (Or we could just use the pointer fallback)
I want to be able to touch and drag left/right to cycle through workspaces like we scroll through them today.
But yeah swaynag can totally just use the pointer fallback.

review_comments: Need to release `wl_touch` in case the seat looses the capability (just like the pointer, see https://github.com/swaywm/sway/pull/3711/files#diff-00a64d3193d21f96087133944068ca3eR393).
